scientific_integrity: Four coefficient inequalities proved exactly; asymptotic window statement proved with fixed damping. Numerical tests are noncertifying diagnostics. No external independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Geodesic unit circle only; no uniform damping limit; finite-window endpoints given implicitly by four exact inequalities. Relevant inaccessible 2016 dissertation leaves a specific originality risk.
title: Resonance windows for damped-cosine geodesic kernels on the circle
